rollups.text: The user collects Funko Pops. On 2023-04-29 or 2023-04-30, the user acquired a limited-edition Marvel Iron Man Pop at a comic-con; it was their 10th Pop. The user was trying to complete an Avengers set and considered buying more Pops. They wanted to display Iron Man on an office desk, possibly with a stand or riser and a Marvel-themed poster or cityscape backdrop.
The user has a Pokémon Trading Card Game collection of 12 binders and more than 5,000 individual cards, reported on 2023-05-01.

The user has traveled or planned trips to several destinations. In April 2023, the user took a seven-day, 2,500-mile road trip to Yellowstone National Park and Grand Teton National Park, staying at five hotels. On 2023-05-22, the user was planning a birthday trip to Kauai, with hiking, waterfalls, local Hawaiian food, and Na Pali Coast snorkeling among their interests. The user planned to visit Seoul in June 2023 and considered Myeong-dong or Hongdae. On 2023-05-25, the user was considering an East Coast trip with three to four days in Boston and three to four in New York City. The user was also planning a birthday trip to Oahu in October 2023, including possible snorkeling, a Manoa Falls hike, and a quiet beach. The user has an undated plan to visit Medellín for a few weeks and Mercado Minorista.

The user planned a birthday trip to Kauai on 2023-05-22; travel dates were unspecified. They explored hiking and waterfalls, wanted to try laulau and kalua pig, and considered snorkeling to see sea turtles and Hawaiian monk seals. The user then decided they thought they would book a Na Pali Coast snorkeling tour and asked for operator recommendations. No booking was confirmed.

The user and their sister argued about the size of their parents’ 30th wedding anniversary celebration roughly three weeks before 2023-05-22. They compromised on a medium-sized party planned for about July 2023. The user suggested inviting close family and close friends of the parents, targeting 30–40 guests and a $2,000–$3,000 budget. They considered hosting at the family home, using the backyard and patio, decorating with balloons, flowers, and candles, and asking others to help. They also considered a slideshow or photo booth. These were plans and ideas, not a confirmed event or venue.

The user had been cooking at home more frequently for about three months as of 2023-05-22 and had made Italian dishes a kitchen staple. They wanted to try Spaghetti Carbonara and Fettuccine Alfredo, aiming to make Carbonara authentically and planning to look for guanciale or pancetta. They checked out cookbooks including The Essentials of Classic Italian Cooking and Jerusalem: A Cookbook, and were interested in new pasta dishes and cooking bulgur and farro.

Around 2023-05-08, the user made tomato soup using a broth they described as delicious. On 2023-05-22, they wanted to reuse the broth for a comforting creamy vegetable soup and chose Creamy Carrot and Ginger Soup. They planned to roast carrots and onions, then sauté garlic and ginger. The user hoped it would turn out as well as the tomato soup; no result was reported.

On 2023-05-25, the user was planning BBQ ribs for a family gathering the following weekend, June 3–4, 2023, and wanted them fall-off-the-bone tender. They chose hickory wood chips, expecting them to pair well with Kansas City-style BBQ sauce, and asked how to set up a gas grill for indirect heat. No evidence confirms that the ribs were cooked.

The user has been caring for houseplants and asked multiple plant-care questions on 2023-05-24: how to avoid overwatering a struggling basil plant; whether to reduce orchid feeding from every two weeks to every four to six weeks in winter; how to propagate a snake plant; and how to care for recently potted spider plant babies. The user also wanted to build a habit of checking plants every morning. No later outcomes were recorded.

The user completed a 20-mile bike ride along a lake trail on October 8, taking about 2 hours and 15 minutes; the year was not specified. The user later completed a charity 5K and set a personal best, with no time given. On 2023-05-24, the user considered bike-run brick workouts to improve running and said they were trying to add more bike rides. They also asked about road-cycling safety. The user had not confirmed starting brick workouts.

The user participates in recreational sports and exercise. They completed a charity 5K with a personal-best result on 2023-05-24 and reported a 20-mile lake-trail bike ride on October 8 (year unspecified), completed about a week before the 5K. On 2023-05-24, they said they played in a recreational volleyball league at a local community center and had served five aces across their previous two games; they wanted to improve serving consistency, especially the toss.

As of 2023-05-27, the user was trying to get into performing stand-up comedy. They attended open-mic nights, aimed to write at least five new jokes daily, and frequently attended live shows, aiming for at least two per week. They kept material in a physical comedy journal but found it disorganized and considered using an app or software. Their observational material included how people order coffee and behave on public transportation, as well as their own habits and quirks. On 2023-05-26, they saw Alex Stevens at the Laugh Out Loud club and said the show was amazing. No debut performance or organization-tool choice was confirmed.

The user was developing a personal narrative about their music journey by 2023-05-23. They planned a section titled “Breaking Free” about self-discovery, obstacles, renewed freedom and passion, growth, and resilience, and wanted to transition with “that brings us to today” in first person. An assistant draft included a move to Toronto, but that was assistant-generated and is not confirmed autobiographical information. The user later said the existing sections brought the story to the present and asked for actionable steps to plan the music journey’s future.
rollups.topic: personal narrative and future music plans

rollups.text: The user developed a strong interest in musical theater by 2023-05-23. They watched and rewatched the filmed Hamilton on Disney+, especially praising Leslie Odom Jr. as Aaron Burr, and had listened to the soundtrack nonstop for about a month. They were taking an online course on musical-theater history and had completed a unit on Stephen Sondheim. They planned to watch The Lehman Trilogy and start with In the Heights, and were interested in further musicals, plays, books, and documentaries about musical-theater history.

The user works as a software engineer consultant for Clark/Sullivan Construction (C/S). On 2023-05-23, the user was preparing a proposal, discussed with C/S’s IT manager, to replace the subcontractor onboarding workflow based on PDFs, scanning, email, and manual re-entry. The proposed solution would use C/S’s existing DocuSign subscription and Box, with the user setting up the workflow and a custom webhook or integration to copy completed files to Box and send appropriate emails. The proposal was to go to upper management for approval; approval or implementation was not confirmed. The system would address different California and Nevada packets and office/field requirements, improve consistency and reduce back-and-forth, but would not eliminate manual accounting data entry. The user emphasized security for sensitive documents and lower costs than building a replacement system. Sheri Angel maintains the California packet, Kevin Stroupe updates insurance and contribution forms yearly, and the C/S Safety Team updates safety forms.

The user reported that all loyalty-platform test cases had passed and that the project was ready to move to go-to-market on 2023-05-22. The requested launch materials included a Product Brief, Release Notes, internal and external FAQs, User Documentation, a Newsletter Entry, and an Internal Presentation for relevant teams. The platform was described as letting merchants track repeat purchasers, inspect buyer insights, customize rewards and program rules, and integrate marketing platforms. The user requested a user guide, which covered dashboard access, Customers, Rewards, Analytics, Settings, and Help. No launch date or completed release was recorded.

On 2023-05-25, the user was planning a social-media campaign to raise awareness about mental health, with a stated launch date of May 1 (year unspecified). They requested post ideas, hashtags, collaborators and Q&A guests, and mental-health apps and online resources. The user explored combining sustainable living with mental-health awareness and enthusiastically approved integrating sustainable-living practices on 2023-05-25. The campaign’s actual launch and implementation were not confirmed.

The user visited the “Impressionist Masters” exhibit at the City Art Museum with Rachel, a work colleague, on 2023-05-20 and was impressed. The user took photos and considered sharing them with Emily, an art enthusiast, along with facts about Claude Monet’s Water Lilies. On 2023-05-25, the user was learning about Water Lilies, was especially interested in Monet’s cataracts, and preferred starting with books about his life, relationships, and struggles. They considered Monet: The Master of Light by Christoph Heinrich and Claude Monet: Life and Art by Paul Hayes Tucker. The user also had a one-year membership providing free access to city museums and planned to visit the Natural History Museum’s ancient-civilizations exhibit on 2023-05-27 or 2023-05-28.

The user’s aunt was diagnosed with stage 4 cancer in early March 2023. By 2023-05-26, the user felt overwhelmed by personal matters and guilty about not visiting as often as desired because of other commitments. The aunt had a tablet and some technology familiarity, but the user was unsure whether she had used video conferencing. The user planned to set up a Zoom test meeting and considered looking at old photos or watching a favorite show or movie together, accounting for the aunt’s possible fatigue or discomfort. No completed call was reported.

The user owns a 2018 Ford Mustang GT with a 5.0L V8 and said on 2023-05-22 that SpeedShine’s detailing kit was working well. The user decided to try Meguiar’s Gold Class Carnauba Plus wax, asked for compatible air-filter recommendations, and considered a local track day and exhaust or suspension upgrades. The user’s city was not identified, and no track booking, upgrade, or installation was confirmed.

The user reported a major file and folder cleanup around 2023-05-03, creating separate work, personal, and entertainment folders and setting up cloud backup for access from anywhere. The user was considering reorganizing laptop files over the weekend of 2023-05-27 to 2023-05-28 and planned to use descriptive file names and tags or labels. On 2023-05-24, the user had 16 GB of laptop RAM and considered adding 8 GB to reach 24 GB versus prioritizing storage; no decision was made. The user also asked about upgrading from an HDD to an SSD, but no upgrade was confirmed.

The user owns a dog named Max. On 2023-06-02, the user sought advice on ear care and natural flea and tick prevention that would not harm Max. The user also asked for durable, easy-to-clean stainless-steel food and water bowls, showed interest in an orthopedic bed and specifically the Big Barker Orthopedic Dog Bed, and considered an interactive feeder toy to slow Max’s eating. These were inquiries and considerations, not confirmed purchases.

As of 2023-05-27, the user aimed to attend at least two stand-up comedy shows per week and write at least five new jokes per day while trying to get into performing stand-up. These were stated targets, not verified totals achieved.
The user reported serving five aces across their previous two recreational volleyball games on 2023-05-24. They wanted to improve serving consistency, particularly the toss.
